scientific_limitations: Velocity resets alone, at constant positive Poisson rate, with zero initial position and velocity; Brownian velocity increments and zero friction
Earlier literature contains all exact second and fourth moment expressions and the long-time fourth cumulant. The new theorem concerns the unique global maximum of the excess-kurtosis time profile.
No extension to arbitrary reset laws, nonzero initial velocities, or friction is asserted; displayed decimal values are approximations to an exact unique-zero characterization.
Publication-priority risk remains for unindexed or differently stated global unimodality results; independent scientific audit has not been performed.
title: A unique transient kurtosis peak for integrated Brownian motion with velocity resetting
